Class AiProviderUiRegistry

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.provider.AiProviderUiRegistry
public class AiProviderUiRegistry extends Object
A centralized, thread-safe UI registry for mapping AI provider classes to their specialized Swing configuration panels.

This registry maintains clean architectural boundaries by allowing anahata-asi-core to remain 100% UI-agnostic while enabling anahata-asi-swing to register and instantiate custom provider panels (such as GeminiAiProviderPanel or AnthropicProviderPanel).

Inheritance Walk-Up: When looking up a panel class for a concrete provider, this registry automatically walks up the class hierarchy until a registered panel class is found, defaulting cleanly to AiProviderPanel if no specialized panel is registered for that provider type.

anahata

    • getPanelClass

      public Class<? extends AiProviderPanel> getPanelClass(@NonNull @NonNull Class<? extends AbstractAiProvider> providerClass)
      Resolves the most specific AiProviderPanel class for a given AI provider type.

      Walks up the superclass hierarchy starting from providerClass up to AbstractAiProvider to find the closest registered panel class. If no specialized mapping is found, returns AiProviderPanel.

      Parameters:
      providerClass - The concrete class of the AI provider.
      Returns:
      The resolved AiProviderPanel class.
